title: I have a Windows 7 laptop. What version of Python can I install on this machine?
author: JASchulz

text: Python 3.8 is the most recent version of Python that supports Windows 7. 3.8.10 was the last version to have a precompiled installer. If you want to compile from source you can use 3.8.20.
author: steven.rumbalski

text: (Looking at Python Releases for Windows | Python.org, you can see that everything later than Python 3.8 explicitly excludes Windows 7 and earlier as a supported operating system.)
author: chepner

text:
Given that Windows 7 is long out of support, so is every version of Python that supports it. I strongly recommend installing Linux, which will give you a supported OS and the latest (and thus supported) Python versions.
Pretty much any distro will do, here’s one good choice: https://devuan.org/
author: Rosuav
